institution: Eastern Oak College of Nursing Sciences
publishNote: Set publishWorkerUrl to your Cloudflare Worker URL after deploy. GitHub PAT stays only in the Worker secret GITHUB_TOKEN.
authNote: Officer PIN is not stored in this public file. It is verified by the Cloudflare Worker and stored only as a one-way hash in data/auth_pin.json after first login/change.
encryptionNote: Set Worker secret DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY then redeploy. After that, Publish encrypts sensitive data/*.json. Reads use get_store when signed in.
